summary: Temporary account freeze and staged hardware routing for transitioning engineer (loanee)
description:
Issue summary:
A senior engineer (internal ID ENG-9982) is transitioning teams for a two-week knowledge transfer. HR requested a temporary suspension of privileged access while allowing the engineer to continue on-site for handover and to retain a single loaner laptop. We need a timebound account freeze (suspend sudo/privileged org groups), escrow the engineer's personal workstation for audit, and route a company loanee laptop through Device Ops to the new team floor.

Impact:
- If not handled, the engineer will retain privileged access while no longer in the original team, violating least-privilege policy.
- Delaying hardware routing will block the receiving team's ability to spin up test environments for the handover.

Environment:
- Internal: corporate IAM, on-prem KMS, Device Ops shipping (US-West hub).

Requested actions / Acceptance criteria:
1) Suspend membership in sensitive groups (admins, infra-sudo) effective 2026-03-02 09:00 PST, but keep primary OKTA account active for email/calendar.
2) Create a timebound elevated exception for user to access a single ipcvm (non-prod) for handover recordings, expiry 2026-03-14.
3) Mark the personal workstation as 'escrowed' in asset inventory and create a chain-of-custody record.
4) Prepare and ship a sanitized company loaner (asset TAG L-4532) to the receiving team desk by 2026-03-03, tracking number attached.
5) Rotate any service account keys the engineer had access to and document reassignments.

Steps already taken:
- HR provided transition window and signed off on escrow (HR case HR-2026-77).
- Manager confirmed list of service accounts in-use (see comment thread).

Desired outcome:
- Engineer can continue handover without privileged access to production systems.
- Devices reconciled and asset inventory updated, KMS/credential hygiene maintained.

Notes on policy alignment:
- This is a short-term, auditable exception; will follow standard offboarding runbook for final departure if separation occurs.
comments: 2026-02-28 | Priya Shah: Submitted per HR request. Attached signed HR approval and manager's list of service accounts. Need Device Ops ETA for loaner shipment.

2026-03-01 | Evan Liu: Initial triage complete. I will: (1) create timebound group removal playbook, (2) open asset-escrow tag, (3) coordinate with Device Ops for 03/03 shipment. ETA for group suspension set for 03/02 09:00 PST. Blocking: confirmation of ipcvm allocation for handover recordings.
2026-03-01 | Maria Ortega (Manager): Confirmed ipcvm allocation: ipcvm-hand-07 reserved until 03/14. Provided receiving desk location and contact. Please proceed.
2026-03-01 | Device Ops Bot: Asset L-4532 sanitized and ready. Shipping label created: TRACK-889221. Delivery scheduled 2026-03-03 AM to Desk 4B.
investigation_notes: Checked IAM: user is a member of org-admins, infra-sudo, and research-dsl groups. infra-sudo and org-admins will be removed; research-dsl retained read-only for ipcvm access.
Service accounts: svc-data-puller and svc-deploy-legacy had last-used tokens accessible by user. Propose rotate svc-data-puller keys and reassign svc-deploy-legacy to team CI user.
KMS: user has no direct KMS key grants, but had access to a wrapper role. Will follow least-privilege revoke flow to remove wrapper role on 03/02 and regrant as timebound if needed.
Asset inventory check: personal workstation W-773 marked 'in use' in inventory — will update to 'escrowed' and attach chain-of-custody form signed by manager and device ops tech.
resolution: Workaround implemented: groups infra-sudo and org-admins scheduled for suspension 2026-03-02 09:00 PST. Loaner L-4532 shipped with TRACK-889221. Key rotation for svc-data-puller initiated; awaiting successful CI validation. Final closure pending confirmation of key rotations and chain-of-custody upload.
